sources.title: e-Visa Tchad
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / E-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live legal notice identifies the Foreign Ministry and Interior Immigration Directorate as the responsible authorities. The home page says a non-exempt foreigner may submit an eVisa application, but gives no express exhaustion/current-force statement for its displayed exemption list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: tout étranger non exempté de visa ... soumettre sa demande d’e-Visa en ligne

sources.title: Nouvelles tarifications des visas en République du Tchad
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / Sous-Direction de E-Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 11 May 2026 immigration notice requires new non-diplomatic/non-courtesy visa applications through evisa.td and invalidates later outside-platform visas after 21 May, but does not map nationalities to visa liability.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td

sources.title: Mentions légales
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration, International Cooperation and Diaspora / Ministry of the Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The current legal notice attributes evisa.td's technical and editorial operation to Chad's Foreign Ministry and Immigration Directorate and says French content is authoritative.
sources.supportingExcerpt: seuls les contenus en français font foi
